datasets.name: GSI coseismic landslide reference dataset
datasets.verbatim: After the earthquake, GSI analyzed high-resolution aerial photographs and produced a detailed vector (polygon) map of the damage attributable to these landslides (the data are available at https://www.gsi.go.jp/BOUSAI/H30-hokkaidoiburi-east-earthquake-index.html).

datasets.name: JAXA land cover maps
datasets.verbatim: In this study, we use the land cover classification created by JAXA [40]... Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). High-Resolution Land Use and Land Cover Map Products. Available online: https://www.eorc.jaxa.jp/ALOS/en/lulc/lulc_index.htm (accessed on 1 November 2019).

datasets.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) digital elevation model
datasets.verbatim: In this study, we use freely available Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) data [43], which provide a digital elevation model (DEM) of almost the whole globe.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2 imagery
datasets.verbatim: The authors would like to thank... the Sentinel missions for providing the Sentinel-2 imagery.

methods.name: Semiautomatic Pixel-Object Method
methods.summary: An integrated framework that uses adaptive thresholding on multitemporal SAR intensity images to extract increasing and decreasing backscattering segments, followed by masking using land cover and DEM data, and object-based morphological operations to refine landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose a fusion of pixel- and object-based image analysis techniques to detect the damage attributable to mass movements... our method is fully implemented using a high-level and general-purpose programming language (Python 3.6).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced and accessible via public links, and other input datasets are accessible. However, the custom code used for the Semiautomatic Pixel-Object Method is not provided or linked.
